name: DSH 0.2 Coding Agent with Web UI
description: Always-on coding agent built on DeepSeek Harness, with plugins and web UI.

PORT.description: Port of the built-in password gate (Caddy). Railway's healthcheck and public domain use it; keep 8080 unless you also change the domain's target port.

DSH_WEB_USERNAME.description: Username for the Web UI login prompt (letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-').

DSH_WEB_PASSWORD.description: Web UI password, generated at deploy. Copy it from this variable to sign in. The service refuses to start if it is empty or shorter than 12 characters.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional. DeepSeek API key (platform.deepseek.com) for the default model and web search. You can instead save it in the Web UI under Settings > Models, which also supports other providers.

DSH_PERMISSION_MODE.description: Default permission preset for new sessions: read-only, workspace-write (upstream default, asks before wider access) or danger-full-access (no sandbox, no approval prompts). Can also be changed per session in the Web UI.

DSH_TRUSTED_HOSTS.description: Optional. Extra host names the Web UI is reached through, comma-separated (e.g. a custom domain like agent.example.com). The Railway domain is trusted automatically.

DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Any non-empty value turns off upstream's feedback-triggered OpenTelemetry upload. Delete the variable to restore the upstream default.

TZ.description: IANA time zone for the agent's clock and scheduled tasks (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the old container gets on redeploy to stop dsh cleanly (it drains for up to 5 seconds) before it is killed.
